subject: POC MAP: trial readiness snapshot + acceptance heatmap
messages:
From: Nate Liu <nate.liu@finera.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, procurement@finera.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — map and timelines

Kimberly,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. We want to lock a short mutual action plan (MAP) so our evaluation team can run the POC next week. Key asks from our side:
- A checklist of POC milestones with owners and acceptance criteria
- A clear escalation path if we hit infra/model access blockers
- A short meeting cadence to review progress (30 min weekly)

Our tentative timeline: 11/30 start data ingestion, 12/07 run evaluation test set, 12/14 acceptance decision. Can Redwood commit to targeted owners for infra + model tuning?

Also attaching our internal procurement note (procurement@finera.com Cc'd).

— Nate
Finera — Technical PM

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Nate Liu <nate.liu@finera.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, procurement@finera.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP: trial readiness snapshot + acceptance heatmap

Nate — thanks. I put together a short MAP snapshot and an "acceptance heatmap" to make the trial gating explicit. Attached: Finera_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones + owners) and eval_plan_v2.pdf (test set and metrics). High level below; we can update during the first weekly checkpoint on Monday.

Milestones (owner — target — acceptance):
1) Data ingestion (Dev) — target 11/30 — acceptance: sample ingestion of 50k rows, successful schema map + no PII incidents
2) Model access & environment (Infra/Dev) — target 12/01 — acceptance: GPU endpoint reachable from Finera VPC, example inference <200ms median
3) Eval run (Analytics) — target 12/07 — acceptance: baseline vs. Redwood model, primary metric: response relevance (F1-like proxy) >= 0.72
4) Runbook & security checks (CS/Compliance) — target 12/09 — acceptance: SOC2 evidence checklist + logging enabled
5) Acceptance decision (Customer + Redwood) — target 12/14 — acceptance: sign-off doc and go/no-go decision

Blockers tracked right now:
- VPC peering requires a Finera firewall rule (owner: procurement/Finera)
- Sample dataset contains columns with hashed IDs — need mapping for label alignment (owner: Finera Analytics)
- Early perf variance on long sequences, Dev assigned to investigate quantization path impact (owner: dev.patel)

Weekly cadence: Mondays 10:00am PT, 30 min stand — I put the invite draft in the Drive link.

Action items for next checkpoint (owners):
- Finera: share sample mapping file (Nate / procurement) — due 11/27
- Redwood (Dev): validate model endpoint and share connection test (dev.patel) — due 12/01
- Redwood (Marissa): finalize eval metric spreadsheet and threshold definitions (marissa.cole) — due 12/04

Happy to adjust dates if procurement constraints arise.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: dev.patel@redwood.com <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, Nate Liu <nate.liu@finera.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:13:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP: trial readiness snapshot + acceptance heatmap

Adding technical detail on the two infra risk items I flagged: 

1) VPC peering / endpoint reachability:
- Status: requesting Finera firewall rule; we attempted a test handshake from a temporary bastion (blocked by IP)
- Action: need the Finera egress IP whitelist or a temporary NAT rule (Nate — can you share the list?)
- ETA to validate: 24–48 hours once IPs are provided

2) Long-sequence perf variance:
- Root cause hypothesis: current quantized kernel path degrades on >1024 tokens under our current batch settings
- Mitigation: will run a controlled micro-benchmark and a small recompile with alternative attention kernel; this will add ~1 day of work but keeps us on-host and avoids model variant fallback

I'll drop logs to Drive (kv-cache-log-snippet.txt) and post a short runbook snippet by EOD Friday. If Finera prefers a warmed dedicated instance rather than shared hosted endpoint for the trial, let's surface that in the Monday call.

— Dev
Senior Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, Nate Liu <nate.liu@finera.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 09:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC MAP: trial readiness snapshot + acceptance heatmap

Thanks — quick note on evaluation thresholds and a minor edit to the MAP sheet. Proposed acceptance buckets (used in the heatmap):
- Green: primary metric improvement >= +5% vs customer baseline OR absolute metric >= 0.72 (pass)
- Yellow: delta between 0%–5% or abs metric 0.65–0.72 (needs tuning, conditional pass with remediation plan)
- Red: delta <0% or abs metric <0.65 (fail)

For the 12/07 eval run please deliver: raw inference outputs, per-query scoring, and a short summary note with top 5 failure modes. We'll use that to decide whether a 1-week tuning sprint is needed before 12/14.

I updated the MAP workbook: moved the "owner" column earlier and added a quick acceptance definition for each row. Calling out that the acceptance decision will be captured in a sign-off doc (template in Drive).

Marissa
Product Manager — Redwood Inference
